quick_skim.title: MixFormer: Linear Transformer with Mixture of Memory Experts
quick_skim.abstract: State Space Models (SSMs), as a mainstream research direction of linear Transformers, aim to achieve higher efficiency than standard Transformers in long-context modeling. However, existing SSMs suffer from limited input adaptivity and constrained memory capacity, leading to information loss when modeling ultra-long sequences. To address these limitations, we propose MixFormer, a novel linear Transformer that integrates a Mixture-of-Memory-Experts (MoE) mechanism. Specifically, the model maintains differentiated memory states through multiple collaborating memory experts and employs a novel Time-Aware Linear Attention (TALA) mechanism, which leverages learnable exponential decay functions and positional biases to dynamically update memory. This design enables the model to selectively reinforce important historical information while effectively mitigating memory dilution, substantially improving long-range dependency modeling. Experiments on long-sequence text and image generation tasks demonstrate that MixFormer not only achieves significant performance gains but also provides a more sustainable computational backbone for the next generation of web infrastructure.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: MixFormer proposes a linear Transformer with Mixture-of-Memory-Experts and time-aware linear attention to improve memory capacity and adaptivity for ultra-long sequences, reducing attention memory versus standard Transformers.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 状态空间模型等线性Transformer在处理超长序列时存在输入适应性不足和记忆容量受限的问题，导致信息丢失。MixFormer引入混合记忆专家机制，用多个协作的记忆专家维护差异化记忆状态，并设计时间感知线性注意力(TALA)以学习指数衰减和位置偏置动态更新记忆。该方法在保持线性计算复杂度的同时增强了记忆容量和建模灵活性，降低了超长序列建模的内存开销。MixFormer为需要固定大小记忆的高效长上下文模型提供了新架构，也有助于缓解传统KV缓存的内存压力。
